gloss: swing and a miss; fruitless effort

definitions.explanation: swinging the bat but failing to make contact with the ball
an action that fails to achieve its intended result

examples.english: He swung and missed at the breaking ball.

notes:
BASEBALL TERM:
{空振|からぶ}り combines ⟦{空|から}→空：27640_kara⟧ (empty) + ⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧ (swinging). Originally baseball terminology that has extended to figurative use.

BASEBALL CONTEXT:
- {空振|からぶ}り⟦ストライク→ストライク：25892_sutoraiku⟧ - swinging strike
- {空振|からぶ}り⟦{三振|さんしん}→三振：08588_sanshin⟧ - strikeout swinging
- ⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{空振|からぶ}り - big swing and miss

USAGE:
The term is commonly used figuratively to mean any action that fails to achieve results:
- {空振|からぶ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる - to end up fruitless
- {空振|からぶ}り⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧ - nothing but failed attempts

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{三振|さんしん}→三振：08588_sanshin⟧ - strikeout
- ⟦{見逃|みのが}し→見逃す：04576_minogasu⟧ - called strike (not swinging)
- ⟦{凡打|ぼんだ}→凡打：30024_bonda⟧ - weak hit/ground out
